all.name: Groot
all.description: A flora colossus from Planet X, the alien known as Groot exhibits enhanced vitality and the ability to manipulate all forms of vegetation. As sturdy as a towering tree, Groot forges his own way, serving as the team's silent but reliable pathfinder.

item.name: Furious Flora
item.description: Perform a combo with his arms, and the third strike will slightly <Debuff>Launch Up</> the hit enemy airborne.

additional_fields.Range: The first two strikes can reach 3m, while the third strike can reach 4m

item.name: Spore Bomb
item.description: Throw an explosive Spore Bomb that splits into multiple small explosive spores.

additional_fields.Range: Spore Bomb generates a spell field with a 5m spherical radius, while small explosive spores create a spell field with a 1.5m spherical radius
additional_fields.Damage: The projectile itself deals no damage, while Spore Bomb deals 55 damage and explosive spores deal 10 damage
additional_fields.Casting: Single-cast projectile with a downward delay that creates a spell field upon impact
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Spore Bomb explodes into 6 explosive spores

item.name: Thornlash Wall
item.description: Target a location and grow a Thornlash Wall. When <Orange>Awakened</>, it strikes nearby enemies attacked by Groot and his allies.

additional_fields.Cooldown: 2 charges, with each charge taking 6s to recharge

item.name: Flora Colossus
item.description: Wooden walls near Groot will <Orange>Awaken</>, activating an extra effect. Press {PrimaryAttack} while building a wooden wall to continue building additional walls.

additional_fields.Range: A cylindrical spell field with a 24m radius and a height of 40m
additional_fields.Casting: Persistent spell field that surrounds the caster

item.name: Ironwood Wall
item.description: Target a location and grow an Ironwood Wall. When the wall is <Orange>Awakened</>, damage dealt by Groot and nearby allies grants Groot <Buff>Bonus Health</>. Groot gains <Buff>Unstoppable</> while near Ironwood Walls.

additional_fields.Special_Effect: Ironwood Wall heals 40 Bonus Health per second, up to 250 Bonus Health; gain Unstoppable status when within 15m of Awakened Ironwood Walls

item.name: Strangling Prison
item.description: Fire a massive vine cluster that pulls nearby enemies to its center and <Debuff>Imprisons</> them.

additional_fields.Damage: The projectile deals 10 damage, while the spell field deals 70 damage. While imprisoning enemies, it deals 20 damage every 0.5s
additional_fields.Casting: Single-cast projectile with a downward delay that creates a spell field upon impact

item.name: Wild Wall
item.description: Mantis enhances Groot's wooden walls and Loki's Rune Stones with life energy. Groot can additionally unleash a Wild Wall, which, when in <Orange>Flora Colossus</> state, restores health to random nearby allies. Loki's Rune Stones grant allies within <Orange>Regeneration Domain</> a <Buff>Damage Boost</>.
